title: A Characterization of Local Nilpotence for Derivations of Ore Extensions
summary: Let $\Bbbk$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. A recent theorem of I. Pan characterizes the nonzero locally nilpotent derivations of $\Bbbk[x,y]$ in terms of their isotropy groups: such a derivation is locally nilpotent if and only if its isotropy group contains automorphisms of arbitrarily large degree. We study analogues of this characterization for several noncommutative algebras related to the affine plane.
